kind: Post-hoc follow-up to dual-head single-chart trial; same 0910 and 0926, both KEEP and Astra; no official score or real-world truth is used.
mechanism: Each visual boundary head is reconstructed on three cuts: present ego-forward, navigation polyline, learned BODY center reference. Across charts admit only original finite bilateral cells built from observed boundary subcurves. Connect only area-overlapping (>1e-6 m2) components to the one containing the initial center. Compute each head independently then intersect. Preserve every retained real predicted boundary as a continuous veto.
stopping: Exactly the previous search budget, no privileged reference, no extrapolated boundary and no convex hull. Stop following this contrast if there is no verified trajectory.
